notes.title: GPU bottleneck bug will be fixed in the next update and more!
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hello Community,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Today I would like to share some good news about performance improvements and news about Lost Island.[/p][p][/p][p]A lot has already been done to improve performance, but so far the effects have been minimal. Quality has also had to take a back seat from time to time.[/p][p][/p][p]KeepUp Survival had an intense internal GPU bug that was so difficult to track down that it seemed almost impossible to find the problem properly. Even new versions of the engine didn't have the desired effect at first.[/p][p][/p][p]However, after much deliberation, I decided to take a bigger step and switch to the latest engine version in order to carry out further tests.[/p][p]And that's exactly what fixed the GPU bottleneck bug![/p][p][/p][p]Sometimes in development you have the strangest things where you keep asking yourself: what was it again? that's the way it is.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]I can now say: it runs very well![/b][/p][p]Even older computers will be able to play the game properly again with the upcoming update.[/p][p][/p][p]With Ultra Settings + TSR you can now achieve over 130 FPS (without limitation) on Lost Island, and on the Mountain Map it's even over 170 FPS.[/p][p][/p][p][b]GPU utilization used to be a tricky issue.[/b][/p][p]Here, too, the values are now very good: with an FPS limit of 60 FPS, the GPU load is only 50 % to 55 %.[/p][p]Of course, if you want to use higher FPS, you will have a correspondingly higher load - everyone should be aware of that. As it currently stands, it is perfectly tuned.[/p][p][/p][p][b]VRAM usage has also been optimized:[/b][/p][p]In order to reduce the memory consumption of the graphics card, I have reworked many notes.title: Important Information About the New Update! Controller, Backup, Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2]

We have just released a new update. Unfortunately, this update is quite extensive as some structural changes have been made.

[h2]Important:[/h2]

With this update, it is necessary to delete certain files. These files cannot simply be overwritten; otherwise, the game will not recognize the changes.

We have integrated a useful tool that can be found under Settings -> Help. There, you can clear the cache and temporary files as well as create savegame backups.

Clearing the cache and temporary files can be helpful if you encounter issues after an update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/ab8f4536bb934dc71d4ed2c9c624cbb392248453.jpg[/img]

[b]Instructions:[/b] First, download the latest update (Ver. 1.30.03.25), start the game, go to the settings, and perform the deletion. Then close the game, restart it, and reset your keyboard settings. After that, you can configure your settings as usual.

[h2]Controller Support:[/h2]

Based on frequent requests, we have improved and expanded controller support. You can now rely mostly on the controller and are less dependent on a mouse and keyboard. The keyboard is only required for text input.

The controller progress is currently about 80%, and further updates are needed to complete it.

There is still a minor conflict in the code that slightly restricts menu navigation in the main menu and in-game menu when using a controller. However, you should not experience any issues while playing.

The controller button mappings are displayed in the HUD, partially for the most commonly used inputs under Settings -> Inputs.

Please let us know if anything does not work as expected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/8f522e6deeade07043b98877b01564c5ba189165.jpg[/img]

[h2]HUD Icons:[/h2]

The HUD icons have been adjusted for controller use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/0d9121405490b7afd18a6a1013c3d4a04dd4c948.jpg[/img]

[h2]Collisions:[/h2]

After receiving reports about invisible collisions on the map, we conducted a review. It turned out that objects were displayed during development but were not visible to players in the game. This issue has been fixed. Additionally, minor adjustments have been made to trees, objects, and vehicles.

[h2]Languages:[/h2]

Further adjustments have been made in all languages.

[h2]Boats:[/h2]

Following reports that boats were not appearing for the return journey, this issue has been fixed.

[h2]Dynamite:[/h2]

By request, dynamite has been added to the "Tools and Weapons" workbench.

Other requests have not been forgotten and remain on the To-Do list.

[h2]Vehicles:[/h2]

The jeep has received a minor performance adjustment, and both male and female characters now have improved seating positions in vehicles. The issue where vehicles would be thrown around when colliding with trees has also been fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39690137/65e32d7f0e6098803e8895f6a6981694006e234e.jpg[/img]

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to let me know! Thanks for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update Details & Changes
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2]

A new update has just been released. Here are the details:

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[b]Incorrect Reflections:[/b] On water surfaces, whether in the sea or a pond, incorrect reflections of the environment were generated. This issue has been fixed.

[b]Collisions:[/b] Over the course of updates, small issues with collisions have crept in, causing objects like small bushes or flowers to completely block the character. This has also been fixed.

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[b]Main Menu:[/b] A small visual adjustment has been made to the main menu.

[b]Game World:[/b] Improvements have been made to the visual presentation, and bloom effects have been added to enhance the overall look. Graphical adjustments were also made to tone down the overwhelming green-on-green effect, especially on Lost Island, in order to highlight other elements.

[h2]Changes[/h2]

[b]Overhaul:[/b] A larger section behind the big mountain on Lost Island, where the mine is located, has been reworked due to issues with vegetation (trees and bushes). As development progresses, additional areas for looting will be created.

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]

[b]Framerates:[/b] Lost Island continues to be analyzed for issues causing frame rate drops. Further adjustments have been made to improve frame rates.

[h2]Issues[/h2]

[b]Ghosting:[/b] Ghosting occurs when artifacts appear while selecting items such as an axe or in the shadows of trees. This issue is caused by TSR usage and originates from the engine itself, which we have no direct control over. We recommend switching to TAA if the ghosting effect is too distracting. notes.title: Improved Graphics Settings, Multiplayer Fixes & Storage Box Changes
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Community,[/h2]

I want to inform you about a new update that has just been released. Here are the details:

[h2]Graphics Settings[/h2]
From now on, you can use AMD Anti-Lag and Nvidia Reflex. However, it is advisable to use these features with caution, as they are still new to the game and might cause complications.

AMD Anti-Lag can be used together with AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution. However, during our tests, some issues arose when both features were used simultaneously. It is recommended to use either Anti-Lag or AMD FSR individually to avoid potential problems.

Therefore, I recommend trying out the feature first and checking whether it works optimally on your system.

[b]Note:[/b] Nvidia users can also use AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution, but not in combination with Nvidia Reflex. Currently, there is no further information available regarding this.

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]

[b]Animation Issues:[/b] Problems with animations in multiplayer mode have been improved. Specifically, the synchronization of fist punches between players has been fixed.

[b]Climbing:[/b] Issues with the climbing animation and the failure to execute climbing for teammates have been resolved.

[b]Collision:[/b] A collision issue that allowed players to climb invisible obstacles has been fixed.

[h2]Storage Boxes[/h2]

Small additional changes have been made: When dismantling or destroying storage boxes, campfires, and other objects, the contents will now spawn in a small container. Users need to collect or relocate the contents of this container if they wish to keep them. Please note that this spawned container is not permanently saved and will disappear after some time.

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to let me know! Thanks for your support and enjoy the game!

UnStuck is now executed using the Enter key and applies to both the character and vehicles.

A bug was introduced that was triggered by using the horse. This prevented proper climbing after using the horse. This bug has now been fixed. From now on, there should be no more issues in this regard.

The eating animation was not executed correctly; this has now been fixed.

notes.title: Ongoing Work and Improvements - Announcement of the Next Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello community[/b],

I would like to update you on the current work being carried out. I hope you are looking forward to the upcoming update.

This update includes various fixes and improvements, as announced in the last news.

In particular, adjustments have been made to the character and horse to ensure smoother movements.

The issues with the horse, such as jumping and animation errors, which were reported to me, have been fixed.

Additionally, underwater riding or walking with the horse has been corrected and will no longer be possible in the upcoming update. When you enter the water, you will automatically dismount, and the vehicle will disappear after 3 minutes, reappearing at the last saved location with your inventory intact.

The horse will exhibit similar behavior, although we are considering introducing swimming for the horse.

The control of the paraglider has also been fixed and will be included in the upcoming update. You will once again be able to fly smoothly above the clouds.

Another idea that was communicated to me, but often seen as a bug, was the ability to breathe underwater. I had never implemented a function for this, but it will be available in the upcoming update. You will no longer be able to dive indefinitely and will need to surface for air.

The character sprinting has also been improved. Previously, it was possible to sprint indefinitely by pressing two keys in a specific way. This is no longer possible.

The graphics of the game look quite good on Ultra settings, but I was never fully satisfied. I discovered a bug that occurred during the transition from UE4 to UE5, which could not be corrected easily. Various adjustments were made to solve this issue, and now the graphics look much clearer and more pleasant.

As already mentioned, I am aware that the current performance is not optimal, particularly due to the spawning of animals. I am continuing to work on fixing and mitigating this problem.

notes.title: KeepUp Survival: Blossoming Changes!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear KeepUp Survival Community,[/b]

I am excited to announce the exciting developments in KeepUp Survival! After intense work and based on your valuable feedback, I present the latest update. The update is substantial at 15 GB, but this is due to the reconfiguration of the engine.

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Before diving in, there are some crucial points to note that some users may need to address to avoid issues.
[hr][/hr]
Error Message: If an error message appears when starting the game, please check the freshness of your graphics driver. It is also possible that your system is outdated, as the game now relies on DX12, and older PCs may encounter issues. To play nonetheless, enter the following launch command in Steam: -DX11

Key Bindings: The issue with saving key bindings has been successfully resolved. However, some users may need to follow a specific step; otherwise, the game might not save key bindings correctly due to changes made. To fix this, please delete the specified folder, for example, by removing the file:

[code][b]Note:[/b] Make changes only if you know exactly what you are doing! Each user is responsible for their actions.[/code]

C:\Users\PCNAME\AppData\Local\KeepUpSurvival\Saved\

Deleting this folder will allow the game to regenerate files upon startup, and saving key bindings will then work as usual. This instruction applies exclusively to users who have owned the game for an extended period!

Farming System: Preparations went mostly smoothly, but not all possible plants have been integrated yet. Currently usable plants are listed below: Potato, Tomato, Corn, Carrot, Watermelon, Cucumber and Pumpkin.

[b]What to Expect in the Update:[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Revised Farming System:[/b] The farming system has been adjusted to the day-night cycle, influencing your crop yields.

You can now craft the following items: UV light, heat lamp, small and large sprinklers. Manual water addition is done using untreated water! Additionally, you can now use fertilizer to increase yields.

Further improvements and adjustments will occur in the course of development!

[b]Greenhouses and Their Functions:[/b] Existing components allow you to build greenhouses that provide UV light and warmth to your plants even at night.

[b]Game Interface Improvements:[/b]
Minor issues in the HUD have been fixed, and the character preview has been improved for better clarity.

[b]Save Key Bindings:[/b]
Now you can save your individual key bindings. I recommend performing a key binding reset to ensure everything works smoothly.

If the reset still leaves the keys empty, follow the instructions above.

[code][b]Note:[/b] Currently, there may be cases where a reset leaves the keys empty. A solution to this problem is actively being worked on.[/code]

[b]Animal Functions (AI) Overhauled:[/b]
To enhance performance and improve gameplay flow, the AI has been reworked. The AI now reacts to how far you are. When you reach a certain radius, the AI is deactivated. If you exceed another radius, the AI is automatically removed from the game.

When you hunt an animal, it remains until you've harvested everything. However, if you move away, a timer is triggered. This timer ensures that the animal is removed from the game if you do not return.

[b]General Improvements:[/b] I have also fixed other minor issues in the game to optimize the overall gaming experience.

Work has been done to improve frame rates. Currently, there is a known issue on the Lost Island Map in the starting area at the farm, affecting frame rates significantly. Efforts are actively underway to address this problem. If you notice anything in this regard causing frame rate drops, please let me know.

Improvements and issue resolutions have also been made on Red Desert and Tropical Island.

The update will go live shortly. Stay tuned and look forward to experiencing these exciting new features!

Thank you for being part of the KeepUp Survival Community. Your engagement and feedback have played a crucial role in implementing these improvements.

Get ready for more exciting news and get ready to enhance your KeepUp Survival experience!
